import sys
import bisect

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    a = data[1:1+n]
    t = data[1+n]
    a.sort()
    ans = -1
    for i in range(n):
        up = bisect.bisect_right(a, a[i] + t)
        ans = max(ans, up - i)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
